items.summary: Real Madrid cruised to a dominant 4-0 victory over newly promoted Málaga at the Bernabéu, with Jude Bellingham opening the scoring in spectacular fashion before Kylian Mbappé and Arda Güler also found the net to maintain Los Blancos' perfect start under José Mourinho.

source.title: Three Takeaways From Real Madrid’s Rousing Win Over Malaga

items.summary: Mourinho has declared Bellingham is in the Ballon d'Or race after restoring the England midfielder's attacking freedom, with the manager revealing he told Bellingham he no longer wants to see him defending like a second left back as he did under previous coaches.

source.title: ‘Ballon d’Or Race’—Mourinho’s Bold Bellingham Claim Serves As Dig to Alonso, Arbeloa

items.summary: Los Blancos emerged as winners of the summer transfer window after addressing key problem positions with signings including Marc Cucurella, Denzel Dumfries, Ibrahima Konaté, Bernardo Silva and record-breaking €125 million winger Yan Diomande, though Mourinho is urging patience with the 19-year-old Ivorian who has logged just 57 minutes so far.

source.title: The Winners and Losers of 2026 Summer Transfer Window
